LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: VISUALS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided writing: Arabic Alphabet (2 sessions) • Symbols/Characters of
Topic 3.3: Guided Writing: Visuals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing: Visuals. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do you take care of household items?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify simple items found at home
2. use basic descriptive words to name pictures
3. appreciate the role of pictures in effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED WRITING: VISUALS
This lesson teaches Guided Writing: Visuals for Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify simple items found at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use basic descriptive words to name pictures
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of pictures in effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Writing: Visuals using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Writing: Visuals above.
2. Explain Guided Writing: Visuals to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Writing: Visuals.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Writing: Visuals with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Writing: Visuals important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you take care of household items?
2. Why are pictures used to communicate?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify simple items found at home
2. use basic descriptive words to name pictures
3. appreciate the role of pictures in effective communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
